summary: Indexed render dispatch over a small 5-entry handle table. Switches on a1 in 0..5 (via jump table jpt_4D8A40); indices 1..5 each load a handle from the global table dword_8AD398/dword_8AD39C/dword_8AD3A0/dword_8AD3A4/flt_8AD3A8, and index 5 additionally renders a colored quad via QuadRenderWithColor(flt_8AD3A8). When the loaded handle and the render device global dword_8B8DC8 are both non-null, calls sub_553700 on the device. Returns 0 on the success/fall-through path, 1 for an out-of-range index.

operations.description: Switch on a1 (0..5), dispatched through the jump table jpt_4D8A40.
Default case: an index outside 0..5 returns 1 immediately.
Case 0: no handle is loaded; falls through to the shared completion path which checks only the render device.
Case 1: load the handle from global dword_8AD398.
Case 2: load the handle from global dword_8AD39C.
Case 3: load the handle from global dword_8AD3A0.
Case 4: load the handle from global dword_8AD3A4.
Case 5: load the low dword of global flt_8AD3A8 as the handle.
Case 5 only: render a colored quad by calling QuadRenderWithColor(flt_8AD3A8).
Guard on the shared completion path: when the loaded handle v2 and the render device global dword_8B8DC8 are both non-null, call sub_553700 with the device.
Set the result to 0 on the completion path (success or no-op when a guard fails).
Return 0 on the completion path (indices 0..5), 1 on the default out-of-range path.
